description: Offline replay corpus for the S1-12 reducer decision gate. Rationales mirror the release battery (failure output, repeated logs, independent key-value data, Unicode, over-long single line, fabricated receipt, truncated view). sourceTokens are pinned crusher-estimator values; answers are replayed decision answers cycled per chunk; expectedRuns pins the wire-attempt count (cross-checked against the real planner).
